name: Strawberry ZKZ Deli
description:
Lineage: Strawberry x Zkittlez

Type: Indica Dominant 

Terpenes: Limonene, Myrcene, and Caryophyllene

Effects: Stress Relief, Relaxation, Sleepy

Aroma: Sweet, Strawberry, Candy

Strawberry Zkittlez provides an initial wave of euphoric energy that can inspire creativity, which is then followed by a relaxing and happy feeling. The taste features strong notes of slightly overripe berries, tangy strawberry, and candy.
